sloka: ततो हयरथाकीर्णं पताकाध्वजशोभितम्।निर्ययौ राक्षसबलं नर्दमानं युयुत्सया ।। ६.७३.२६ ।।
transliteration: tato hayarathākīrṇaṁ patākādhvajaśobhitam।niryayau rākṣasabalaṁ nardamānaṁ yuyutsayā ।। 6.73.26 ।।

translations.english: The fire god himself, decked in polished gold ornaments turned round and accepted the offerings.
